Welcome! This is my personal, evolving set of notes taken while working through
Carnegie Mellon University's
[AI Engineering Fundamentals graduate certificate](https://www.cmu.edu/online/ai-engineering-fundamentals),
starting with course **24-887 — Machine Learning & AI for Engineers**.

I write these notes mostly to understand things more deeply (e.g. deriving the
gradient-descent update rules by hand, even though real projects would just use a
library) and to keep a searchable refresher for my future self.

## Notes

- [Logistic Regression](notes/logistic-regression.qmd) — deriving the loss,
  gradient, and gradient-descent update for a two-class, two-feature linear classifier.
